title: Accessibility and Alignment of Trans-Cleavage Substrates Modulate the Kinetics of Cas12a Ribonucleoprotein.
authors: Hu, Jianyu; Feng, Wei; Zhang, Hongquan; Le, X Chris
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过建立酶动力学模型并实验验证，定量解析了Cas12a RNP反式切割中底物穿越REC/NUC结构域间隙及与催化三联体对齐的分子机制，为CRISPR系统动力学优化提供了机制基础。
abstract: Mechanistic understanding of molecular interactions involved in the trans-cleavage of CRISPR ribonucleoprotein systems is critical to advance genome editing, cell imaging, DNA nanotechnology, and molecular diagnostics. However, the mechanisms underlying molecular interactions of the substrate with the ribonucleoprotein are not clear. We report here molecular interactions that play critical roles in the trans-cleavage activity of Cas12a ribonucleoproteins. We established kinetics models that quantitatively describe critical molecular interactions involving key functional domains of Cas12a ribonucleoproteins. Experimental validation of the enzyme kinetic models and quantitative determination of the apparent enzyme turnover number (k(*) (cat)) and Michaelis constant (K(*) (M)) enabled detailed studies of the accessibility and the alignment of the substrate with the catalytic site of the ribonucleoprotein. Consistent kinetic model predictions and experimental results indicate the critical importance of two processes: (1) the substrate passing through the gap between the REC (recognition) and NUC (nuclease) domains, determined by K(pass), and (2) the alignment of the substrate with the catalytic triad of the ribonucleoprotein, determined by K(align). Guided by the kinetic models, rational design of substrates and activators enabled quantitative assessment of K(pass) and K(align). These results and fundamental understanding of the molecular interactions involved in the process provide a fundamental basis for improving the kinetics of CRISPR systems.
abstract_zh: 对CRISPR核糖核蛋白系统反式切割中涉及的分子相互作用的机制理解，对于推进基因组编辑、细胞成像、DNA纳米技术和分子诊断至关重要。然而，底物与核糖核蛋白相互作用的潜在机制尚不明确。我们在此报告了在Cas12a核糖核蛋白反式切割活性中起关键作用的分子相互作用。我们建立了动力学模型，定量描述了涉及Cas12a核糖核蛋白关键功能域的分子相互作用。酶动力学模型的实验验证以及表观酶转换数（k(*) (cat)）和米氏常数（K(*) (M)）的定量测定，使得对底物与核糖核蛋白催化位点的可及性和对齐进行详细研究成为可能。一致的动力学模型预测与实验结果指出了两个过程的关键重要性：（1）底物通过REC（识别）和NUC（核酸酶）域之间的间隙，由K(pass)决定；（2）底物与核糖核蛋白催化三联体的对齐，由K(align)决定。在动力学模型的指导下，底物和激活剂的合理设计使得K(pass)和K(align)的定量评估成为可能。这些结果及对该过程中分子相互作用的根本理解，为改善CRISPR系统的动力学提供了基础。
